notes: Lighter with many players online: Expansive Inventory and Wanderers of the Wilds do less work every tick (the same behavior).

stash_bp.notes: Expansive Inventory does less work every tick with many players online: it keeps its own list of who is online instead of asking the game every 2 ticks, and skips players who are dead until they respawn.

wander_bp.notes: Wanderers' name labels cost less with many players nearby: between the once-a-second full checks, the labels near players reuse the players found then instead of asking the game again every 2 ticks.
